custom_starting_init_01 = {
	class = "rl_trinary_stars"
	usage = custom_empire
	flags = { empire_home_system }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}
